limits: Actual compiled local app in isolated synthetic signed-out contexts; no production state, install/build/deploy/provider/account/purchase operation.
Genuine native IDB readwrite transaction is held before native put using bounded native get requests; this amplifies a real pending-save window without claiming its ordinary duration.
Private course draft/optimistic projection may change while pending; only public saved display and committed IDB authority are checked.
Headless bringToFront may not deliver trusted focus; any explicit synthetic focus event is labelled, not represented as genuine focus.
Mobile screenshots are Chromium viewport emulation, not physical iOS testing.
